scope: Independent compiled enemy config merge review; no functional milestone

rules.blackboard: For each incoming pair remove every same-key target pair, then append reconstructed numeric/string pair; unmatched target order retained
rules.talents: Allocate only if computed board is null and incoming list nonnull/nonempty; then per-key helper merge. Null/empty incoming preserves old board. Initial null remains null.
rules.skills: For each delta find first old same-prefab. Only if found and delta board nonempty: deep-clone delta, copy old nonempty board or new empty board, apply incoming pair merge, remove all old same-prefab, append clone. Otherwise remove all and append whole delta without pair normalization.
rules.skill_caller: Begin from old skill array copy or empty list. Incoming null/empty does not clear old list. Final empty list is stored as null; nonempty stored as array.
rules.pair_numeric: valueStr null/empty -> incoming value retained, valueStr null
rules.pair_string: valueStr nonempty -> value set0, valueStr retained
rules.clone: Exact ObjectExtensions.DeepClone<ESkillData>; BinaryFormatter/MemoryStream roundtrip. Delta scalar values including zero preserved; old scalars are not merged.

review_corrections.issue: Initial talents claim of unconditional board rebuild was wrong
review_corrections.cause: Reviewer clipped caller window at0x182417cea and omitted old-board guard atce3/ce8

limitations: Compiled baseline only; source parameters and active hotfix/controller are distinct.
No execution of target DLL, BinaryFormatter, game, or runtime calls.
Serialization conclusion restricted to this six-field Serializable ESkillData with no custom methods/interfaces; no general clone guarantee for arbitrary types.
No level fallback, stage alias, controller, skill activation/first/cycle clock inferred.
